title: Data Privacy & Security
completion_message: ¡Formidable! En la era digital, los datos son el activo más valioso. Entender los términos de ciberseguridad y privacidad de datos te protege a ti y a tu empresa de desastres multimillonarios.

parts.visual:
Los datos corporativos están bajo amenaza constante. Conoce este vocabulario: 

1. Data breach (Filtración / Brecha de datos): 
- Cuando información confidencial es robada o expuesta. 
Ej: The DATA BREACH exposed the passwords of 5 million users. 

2. GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation): 
- La estricta ley de privacidad de Europa. Violarla cuesta millones. 
Ej: Is our new software fully GDPR compliant? 

3. Opt-in / Opt-out (Aceptar participar / Rechazar participar): 
- 'Opt-in' significa que el usuario debe dar permiso explícito (ej. marcar una casilla) para recibir correos. 'Opt-out' es cuando se le incluye por defecto y debe pedir salir. 
Ej: European laws require strict OPT-IN consent for marketing emails.
parts.audio: Welcome to Data Privacy and Cybersecurity. Corporate data is under constant threat. Number 1: Data breach. An incident where confidential or protected information is exposed or stolen. For example: The DATA BREACH exposed the passwords of 5 million users. Number 2: GDPR, which stands for General Data Protection Regulation. This is Europe's strict privacy law. For example: Is our new software fully GDPR compliant? Number 3: Opt-in and Opt-out. Opt-in means the user must actively give permission, like checking a box, to receive emails. Opt-out means they are included by default and must ask to be removed. For example: European laws require strict OPT-IN consent for marketing emails.

parts.visual:
4. Encryption (Cifrado / Encriptación): 
- Ocultar datos convirtiéndolos en código secreto. 'End-to-end encryption' significa que solo el emisor y receptor pueden leerlos. 
Ej: All our messages are secured with end-to-end ENCRYPTION. 

5. Phishing (Suplantación de identidad): 
- Correos falsos diseñados para robar contraseñas simulando ser empresas reales. 
Ej: The employee clicked on a PHISHING link and compromised the network. 

6. Ransomware (Secuestro de datos): 
- Un virus que bloquea los archivos de una empresa hasta que pagan un rescate ('ransom'). 
Ej: The hospital's systems were shut down by a RANSOMWARE attack. 

7. NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement / Acuerdo de confidencialidad): 
- Contrato legal para no revelar secretos. 
Ej: Before I show you the prototype, you must sign this NDA.
parts.audio: Number 4: Encryption. The process of converting information or data into a code, especially to prevent unauthorized access. For example: All our messages are secured with end-to-end ENCRYPTION. Number 5: Phishing. Cyber attacks that use deceptive emails to trick people into revealing passwords or clicking malicious links. For example: The employee clicked on a PHISHING link and compromised the network. Number 6: Ransomware. Malicious software that blocks access to a computer system or files until a sum of money, a ransom, is paid. For example: The hospital's systems were shut down by a RANSOMWARE attack. Number 7: NDA, which stands for Non-Disclosure Agreement. A legal contract keeping information secret. For example: Before I show you the prototype, you must sign this NDA.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de privacidad o seguridad correcto.

questions.question: The company was fined $50 million after a massive data ____ exposed customer credit cards. (Brecha / Filtración).
questions.explanation: Data breach = filtración o brecha de datos.

questions.question: If you do business in Europe, your software must be fully compliant with the ____ regulations.
You cannot subscribe users automatically. They must actively check a box to ____-in to our newsletter. (Aceptar explícitamente).
If users no longer want to receive our emails, there must be a clear link at the bottom allowing them to ____-out. (Darse de baja).
questions.explanation: Opt-out = elegir no participar o darse de baja.

questions.question: To ensure hackers cannot read the database, all passwords are protected using military-grade ____. (Cifrado).
The hacker sent an email pretending to be the CEO asking for passwords. This is a classic ____ attack. (Suplantación).
questions.explanation: Phishing = correos fraudulentos para robar datos.

questions.question: All our files were locked by hackers who demanded 50 Bitcoin to unlock them. We were hit by ____. (Secuestro de datos).
questions.explanation: Ransomware = software que pide un rescate (ransom).

questions.question: Before our engineers look at your proprietary code, they will sign a strict ____. (Acuerdo de confidencialidad).
A hacker who finds security flaws to help a company fix them (legally) is called a '____ hat' hacker.
When a system requires both a password and a code sent to your phone, it is using Two-Factor ____ (2FA). (Autenticación).
questions.explanation: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) = Autenticación de dos factores.

questions.question: A vulnerability in software that is completely unknown to the vendor and has no patch yet is called a '____-day' exploit.
questions.explanation: Zero-day exploit = vulnerabilidad de día cero.

questions.question: To prevent internal data theft, employees should only have access to the data necessary for their job. This is the principle of 'least ____'.
questions.explanation: Principle of least privilege = principio de menor privilegio.

questions.question: The company's servers were overwhelmed by fake traffic in a massive ____ attack. (Ataque de denegación de servicio).
A hidden method used by hackers to bypass normal authentication and access a system is called a ____. (Puerta trasera).
Any software intentionally designed to cause damage to a computer or network is broadly called ____. (Software malicioso).
A network security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on rules is a ____. (Cortafuegos).
The 'ransom' in ransomware refers to the money demanded by the attackers. What does 'ransom' mean?
If your personal data is collected, the company must specify the ____ of the data collection clearly. (Propósito).
Under GDPR, users have the 'Right to be ____', meaning they can request their data be completely deleted. (Olvidados).
questions.explanation: Right to be forgotten = el derecho al olvido.

questions.question: When data is rendered anonymous in such a way that the person is no longer identifiable, it is called data ____. (Anonimización).

Locked files by ____. (Virus de rescate con R)
